resolutions.action: Extended cross-change OUT bullet at specs/orbit-address-reviews/spec.md:40 to explicitly cover both active and archived changes. New bullet: `OUT — cross-change directories (active and archived): openspec/changes/<other-name>/* (other active changes' directories) AND openspec/changes/archive/* (any archived change, regardless of date prefix). Change-isolation invariant for active changes; immutable-history invariant for archived changes. Cascade never edits either, even when the current change's ripple-flag set surfaces a path inside one. The corresponding scenario `Cascade respects current-change scope only` documents both cases.` Closes the gap between normative bullet and scenario.

Rewrote `Cascade skips safe-exclusion paths` scenario at specs/orbit-address-reviews/spec.md:76-79. Old WHEN: `.git/`, `node_modules/`, `dist/`, `build/`, 'or another safe-exclusion path'. New WHEN: `exactly one of the four safe-exclusion prefixes: .git/, node_modules/, dist/, build/`. Added normative postscript: `The safe-exclusion prefix set is EXACT — implementers MUST NOT extend it ad-hoc to other paths during codegen. Expanding the set requires a spec change to amend this list explicitly; the Option D framing depends on the OUT list being closed and predictable.` Closes the implementer-invention escape hatch.

Updated the heuristic-trigger bullet at specs/orbit-address-reviews/spec.md:154 to explicitly accept BOTH bold variants of the Options-prefix and require markdown normalization. New text: `'Options:' prefix followed by a list or numbered enumeration, including both bold variants (`**Options**:` with the colon outside the bold span, AND `**Options:**` with the colon inside the bold span) — both are accepted equivalently after markdown normalization. Implementers SHOULD normalize the input's markdown emphasis before pattern-matching this trigger so the detector behaves consistently across the two conventions.` Cascaded to design.md:100 to match the spec's accept-both-after-normalize rule. design.md:48, design.md:188, proposal.md:15 retain the shorthand `**Options:**` reference (now one of two equivalent forms; not incorrect, just abbreviated).
